title: Zechariah
lead: Zechariah is the eleventh of the Twelve Minor Prophets and the longest, with 14 chapters. Chapters 1-8 are dated to 520-518 BC, in the same weeks and province as Haggai: a call to turn back, eight visions in one night, the crowning of Joshua and a question about fasting. Chapters 9-14 are two undated oracles whose author and date are debated.
